title: Azahar 2126.0-alpha1: official alpha build
summary: Azahar published 2126.0-alpha1 on May 16, 2026. The release record documents an official alpha build for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2126.0-alpha1 on May 16, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Introduced the new "MXE" build variant previously discussed in an announcement on our Discord server. @OpenSauce04 2044. This new variant will serve as the replacement for the now-deprecated MSYS2 variant, which, as also previously discussed in the above post, will be removed in the 2127.0 update. Users will be able to migrate from MSYS2 to MXE seamlessly, so existing MSYS2 users have no cause for concern. For more information about this build, please read the aforementioned announcement post.
